FU1.label: Agent-owned follow-up

FU1.1.label: Callback committed
FU1.1.description: Agent committed to calling the customer back within a specified or unspecified timeframe.

FU1.2.label: Email follow-up or confirmation committed
FU1.2.description: Agent committed to sending a follow-up email - confirmation, summary, or further information.

FU1.3.label: Case investigation committed
FU1.3.description: Agent committed to investigating the issue further and reporting back with findings.

FU1.4.label: Progress monitoring committed
FU1.4.description: Agent committed to monitoring a pending action (shipment, fix, refund) and proactively updating the customer.

FU1.5.label: Document or evidence to be provided
FU1.5.description: Agent committed to sending a document, invoice, report, or evidence to the customer.

FU1.description: The agent committed to performing a specific action after the interaction ends.

FU2.label: Customer-required action

FU2.1.label: Customer to provide documentation or evidence
FU2.1.description: Customer must submit a document, screenshot, bank statement, or other evidence.

FU2.2.label: Customer to attempt fix and report outcome
FU2.2.description: Customer was given instructions to try and must contact again to report whether the fix worked.

FU2.3.label: Customer to complete a process or form
FU2.3.description: Customer must complete an online form, application, verification step, or portal action.

FU2.4.label: Customer to contact a third party first
FU2.4.description: Customer must contact their bank, carrier, or another provider before resolution can proceed.

FU2.description: The customer must take a specific action after the interaction to advance the resolution.

FU3.label: Internal team action

FU3.1.label: Engineering team to investigate or fix
FU3.1.description: The engineering or technical team must diagnose and fix a bug or system issue.

FU3.2.label: Finance or billing team to process
FU3.2.description: The finance team must process a refund, credit, or billing correction.

FU3.3.label: Operations or fulfilment team to act
FU3.3.description: The operations, logistics, or fulfilment team must take action (reship, rebook, expedite).

FU3.4.label: Compliance or management review required
FU3.4.description: A compliance officer, manager, or senior stakeholder must review the case before it can close.

FU3.description: A specific internal team (not the current agent) must complete an action to close the case.

FU4.label: Automated or system follow-up

FU4.1.label: Automated refund or credit to be processed
FU4.1.description: A system-triggered refund, credit, or billing adjustment will be processed automatically.

FU4.2.label: Automated notification or confirmation to be sent
FU4.2.description: An automated email, SMS, or in-app notification will be sent to the customer by the system.

FU4.3.label: Scheduled system task to trigger
FU4.3.description: A time-based system task (renewal, expiry, delivery window) will execute automatically.

FU4.description: An automated system or scheduled process will handle the follow-up without further human action.

FU5.label: No follow-up required

FU5.1.label: Fully resolved - no follow-up needed
FU5.1.description: The issue was completely resolved during the interaction; nothing further is required.

FU5.2.label: Customer chose not to pursue
FU5.2.description: The customer acknowledged and closed the interaction without needing further action.

FU5.description: The interaction is complete. No post-interaction action is needed from any party.
